summary:
I independently read the newly frozen TASK-0136 spec f5127c3233174b10cd57aed4949a9536037dc5297041f0993bb115113edb1f7f in full, its exact four-added-line diff, and the authoritative Fixed native-ownership output in revision 2 Norm section at commit 68aed163fb165e9ef2d9b59acb5b43b4f990a2d4, raw Norm SHA0051a57b4bfec08efcd8e0d08ea011b0c9c7621ab060b8f22df833a913136d93. The actual current design-context builder returns 9c735f0609fdb11e2177c48904d0ee1cd215c433e1b2a7ddb09b1d469ffa8427 and exactly matches the supplied context original. This is a fresh standard review bound to that refrozen spec/context, not reuse of the earlier b13e8c context or REV-0001/REV-0002 authority.

The supplement is within the same requested ordinary-installed agent-bridge-node@2 Goal and existing Task136. I compared actual task scope and decision units with the committed baseline: neither expands. HEAD and subject remain 68aed163fb165e9ef2d9b59acb5b43b4f990a2d4 and the genuine original base remains 5a802cd1bb60a23d01bc0fa0a7922026176855f6. Classification remains REVIEW/V2 under unchanged native Policy2.6 with fresh input e8e4c4c52df8ffe8ce0182a3aa592828063b2e6556eb6734b87af189805d75f3. The full original-base-to-current executable diff denominator and 90percent threshold remain required; the design does not create a smaller source task or reduce the denominator.

The new paragraph correctly binds only the exact reviewed CS7972a55b7a45bd00e557eae709d228c69f04f460c8057614ea820bf18da4b8f3 and producer TS438e19b624334a59e8346f767b5a16eaffa01b811b3b9a4238a94e038f394007 roles, their actual source identities, corresponding source-derived dist and existing OS PowerShell/compiler/configuration/resource-tool closure. At revision-2 V0/V1/V2 it requires source-derived applicability before product processes/prepared writes: both absent forbids native cache/fixture, single or unsupported/unsafe role rejects early, both exact requires complete cache immediately after actual successful fixed node_check and Job/EOF/cleanup. The exact two-file/sidecar-wire inventory is sealed then preserved before every subsequent fixed execution, at plan completion and successful replay. No self-consistent sidecar or caller JSON grants a role. Successful replay independently checks applicability, successful receipt, actual executable bytes, identity/membership and existing original/run/snapshot/review/approval bindings. Failed/unreached checks retain bounded actual partial diagnostics without repair, recompilation, cleanup, success exemptions or invented shapes.

The new acceptance bullet covers that complete matrix, seal/coverage/end/replay drift, strict content/tool/member rules, unknown neighbors, failed-stage preservation and unchanged revision1 behavior. It requires fresh direct-wheel and sdist-rebuilt ordinary engines for the changed implementation, fresh verifier contexts and single-use actions, five actual installed baseline/mutant pairs, full pre/independent-review/same-verifier-final/code-approval/Gate lifecycles, and preservation of every old failed original. The rest of the spec retains actual full-product tests, complete source native V2 and both branch coverage domains, all unchanged native operators/checks/argv, original timeouts/storage/JSON budgets, 85/90 thresholds, independent review and exact-head CI before merge. Node CI capability remains unavailable and its separate overall-goal stage is not claimed complete. No actual target write, remote/real-model/WeChat/phone call, credentials, paid call, private export or new permission is granted. Safe test/doc transport remains separately authored and scoped; no generic execution or trace framework is added.

This remains the dist trusted-host output boundary, not independent CS-to-IL certification, historical EXE pinning or PE normalization. The prior high design finding NATIVE-OUT-001 and original REQUEST_CHANGES report remain preserved; design-only closure is build/adoption/native-output-design-review-r2.json SHA8a2e2997ce0bc5384517b5066b11bf7e91f978204599e99ac0a2e91a665917d2. I find no open current design issue in this refrozen narrow spec. APPROVE is a design conclusion only. No native-output implementation is accepted or claimed to exist by this review. Spec approval and implementation begin remain subsequent authorized CLI decisions; code approval, actual ordinary/native PASS, Gate, Node CI and completed integration are not granted by this record. I authored none of the implementation under review and ran no compiler, test, product, Node or network process. Only the explicitly authorized formal review artifacts/context/event and ignored standard input are written; there is no commit, spec approval, state escalation, source/test/Norm/spec edit or failed-original repair.
